# omodroid

> Planned Android launcher and overlay for the Omoda 5 (2023) infotainment head unit (Chery Omoda). Early stage: the repository holds no source code or release yet.

There is nothing to install yet. The README has a short Turkish section ("Omoda 5 multimedya ekranına uygulama yükleme") that says the same for Turkish owners. Do not describe features, install steps or supported firmware versions; none are published.

## Docs

- [Website](https://projects.halit.org/omodroid/): project status, how to follow or contribute, and a general explainer on Android car launchers
- [README](https://github.com/halitsever/omodroid/blob/main/Readme.md): project summary and current status
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/halitsever/omodroid/blob/main/AGENTS.md): CI check and conventions for contributors
